title: message.json
description: A single channel message. Stored at threads/<thread-id>/messages/<seq>-<timestamp>-<alias>.json. See mad.council.a2a.md §7.3.

schema_version.description: Message-doc schema version per schemas/README.md §Schema-version increment invariant (ADOPT-036). Current = 2 (triage-* types added). Absent == 1 (pre-ADOPT); readers up-convert.

id.description: Sequential message identifier; unique within the channel.

seq.description: Monotonic channel-level sequence number from seq.json.

thread_id.description: Thread ID this message belongs to. Absent only for unparented top-level messages (discouraged).

from.description: Author identity. session_id is bound at post time per §7.2 spoofing-defense.

type.description: Message type vocabulary. Core six (task / question / answer / status / fyi / resolve) per spec §7.3. triage-question + triage-context added per ADOPT-002 / rules/triage-gate.md — only valid when channel.status = triage.

body.description: Message content; hard-capped at 32KB per §8.5 body-size cap.

in_reply_to.description: Optional reference to the message being replied to.

mentions.description: Aliases mentioned in the body; validated against channel.members at post time.

run_id.description: Correlation key per wiki/patterns/run-id-correlation.md. RFC 4122 any variant (v4 convention).

a2a_task_id.description: A2A task identifier when transport is a2a-*. Maps to the remote system's task.

body_size_bytes.description: Computed at post time for the cap enforcement in §8.5.

suspicious.description: True when Rule-1 literal-phrase scan trips at post time. Readers render with ⚠️ badge.
